messages:
sophia: Postmortem follow-up: billing lag in token aggregation caused delayed usage to appear on later invoice runs. We have to track remediation owners + timeline, and prepare invoice corrections.

mike: I'll pick up the collector hotfix. Current short-term plan: reduce aggregation window for active streams from 60s -> 15s and add a periodic flush every 45s. Aim to ship hotfix in 48h. Longer-term rework of the aggregator state machine in 10 days.

anita: I'll coordinate the invoice adjustments and customer outreach. Need an export of affected invoices + suggested credit per invoice. Can someone run the detection query?

devon: Running the scan now. Query: SELECT tenant_id, invoice_id, reported_tokens, corrected_tokens, occurrence_count FROM token_ledger WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2026-02-10' AND '2026-02-12' AND review_needed = true;

billing-bot: Scan complete: 92 rows. Added fields token_delta and est_credit_usd. Sample: tenant_993, invoice_20260211_05, reported 24_300, corrected 23_100, token_delta 1_200, est_credit $3.60

julia: A couple policy points: auto-apply credits under $75; anything >= $75 requires finance + AM signoff. Recurring definition: more than 2 incidents in 60d -> escalate to product & AM.

sophia: Sounds reasonable. Also add a priority flag = (est_credit >= $120) or occurrence_count >= 2.

mike: I'll create a short-lived feature flag to roll the hotfix to 10% traffic first, monitor token_delta metric and queue lag. Will add integration tests for flush behavior.

anita: Devon, can you stage a preview apply run? We want a CSV for review and a preview of ledger impact.

devon: Staging preview ready. 92 rows, total estimated liability $198.45. No invoice duplicates detected, 12 tenants have occurrence_count > 1.

anita: I'll review and prepare customer templates: brief apology, root cause (aggregation lag), credit line, contact info. Plan: no outbound until credits applied, internal alert to AMs for high-priority accounts.

julia: I'll add a recurrence detection job to flag tenants with >2 incidents/60d and surface on the billing dashboard. Target: 7 days.

sophia: Action items summary:
- A1: Hotfix (aggregation window -> 15s + periodic flush) 0% rollout then 100% 0 owner: mike 0due: 48h 0status: started.
- A2: Detection query & affected invoice export 0 owner: devon/billing-bot 0due: next morning 0status: done (92 rows).
- A3: Staging credit apply preview 0 owner: devon/anita 0due: 24h 0status: preview ready.
- A4: Customer communication templates + CC rules 0 owner: anita 0due: 48h 0status: drafting.
- A5: Recurrence detection & dashboard flag 0 owner: julia 0due: 7 days 0status: planned.
- A6: Full aggregator redesign & tests 0 owner: mike 0due: 10 days 0status: backlog.

mike: I'll post PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/usage/collector/pulls/420 (WIP). Adding metric: billing.backlog.tokens and alert if >2000 tokens/min for >5m.

anita: Finance sign-off: I approve auto-credits < $75. For credits >= $75, need my OK + AM loop. For credits >= $500, legal review for any contractual notices.

devon: Access request: need payment-run tool rights for dry-run apply. Tagging @sophia for approval.

sophia: Approved for dry-run access to devon tonight. Dry-run only, do not push credits live.

billing-bot: Dry-run apply completed: preview ledger entries generated for 92 invoices, total est liability $198.45, flagged 12 recurring tenants, flagged 7 high-priority invoices (>=$120).

julia: I'll open a meta-incident ticket to track recurrence history and link to this thread. Owner: julia.

anita: After audit I'll schedule small-batch applies for credits <$75 tomorrow morning and send internal note to AMs for high-priority accounts.

sophia: Thanks team. Please update the central remediation tracker with PR link, CSV snapshot, and final apply timestamp. We'll close when A1-A4 are completed. :white_check_mark:
